about: Open items a PO noted during a destination check, to settle later. tools/flags.py shows each as a flag until it is removed from this file.

open.title: Bali: Pocket Wifi prices look swapped
open.detail: Pocket Wifi 3GB 4D3N sells at RM120 (cost RM28) but 10GB at RM80 (cost RM48) — the larger plan is cheaper.
open.fix: Confirm both selling prices on the Add On tab.

open.title: Bali: TripCare 360 prices differ from Aceh
open.detail: Bali has only the TripCare set at RM64 (Individual 1–5 days); Aceh and Aceh-Sabang keep the RM45 set (PO 11 Oct 2026).
open.fix: Pick one TripCare price list and use it for Bali too.

open.title: Bangkok: tipping not in the costing
open.detail: The catalog includes Tipping (basis Ground & Tipping) but neither the Chiwanon CR nor the R&D sheet has a tipping cost.
open.fix: Ask Chiwanon whether driver tipping is inside the rate; if not, add a tipping component.

open.title: Bangkok: hotel contracts end 31 Oct 2026
open.detail: Almas, Al-Meroz and Nouvo City contracts are valid to 31 Oct 2026; the catalog is sold to 31 Mar 2027.
open.fix: Get the 2026–27 hotel contracts and update the Almas rates (FIT / group).

open.title: Bangkok: Giraffe Encounter margin under 10%
open.fix: Keep or raise the catalog price.

open.title: Bangkok: 4★ upgrade margin thin
open.detail: Nouvo City Superior Classic 2,000 THB vs Almas 1,250 THB = ~RM46/pax/night against the RM50 upgrade (~9%).
open.fix: Keep or raise the 4★ upgrade surcharge.
